name: sigma-life-os
description: Σ Life OS — explainable personal decision layer (web PWA, Firebase backend, Capacitor mobile).

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w functions
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w functions
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/web && npm run test -w functions && node --test services/local-ai-gateway/server.test.mjs
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-sigma "vitest run --config tests/rules/vitest.config.ts"
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.deploy:static: npm run build -w apps/web && firebase deploy --only hosting --config firebase.static.json --project project-sum-b961a
